response.justification: Bogdan brings 13+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, mobile, embedded and backend systems, with a CS degree and genuine high-throughput experience (micro-services handling millions of requests/second at Sociomantic) plus strong testing/craftsmanship and community-teaching credentials. However, the role is a Principal/IC6 growth-and-experimentation systems position, and the resume shows no experimentation platforms, feature flighting, A/B testing, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis work. Career trajectory is senior/staff IC at small-to-midsize companies rather than principal-level ownership of multi-team, multi-workstream initiatives at enterprise scale, and there is little evidence of cross-org influence with Product/Data Science partners. The language stack also skews to TypeScript/Node and DLang rather than the platform-scale ecosystems emphasized here.
strengths: 13+ years hands-on across full stack, including low-latency high-throughput services
Strong engineering fundamentals: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, open-source tooling
Proven knowledge-sharing and mentoring via workshops, talks, and courses
concerns: No experimentation, feature-flagging, or growth-measurement platform experience
Little evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/data analysis depth
Scope and influence below Principal/IC6 expectations for multi-team enterprise initiatives

key_factors.factor: Depth of engineering experience and distributed-systems exposure
